home.introEyebrow: A Home Fragrance Brand Inspired by Lanna Heritage
home.introText: Poetiq blends the delicate artistry of Lanna pattern with the serenity of Northern Thailand's forests, tea gardens, and lantern-lit evenings — carried into scent for everyday living spaces.
home.storiesText: From the highland forests of Chiang Mai to the oolong tea plantations of Chiang Rai and the lantern festival of Sukhothai — each Poetiq scent is built around a memory of Northern Thailand, with its own top, heart, and base notes.
home.followText: Scent stories and studio updates, shared on Facebook and Instagram.

shop.headerText: Ten ways to bring Northern Thailand's forests, tea gardens and lantern-lit evenings into your home. Choose a scent for each piece below.
shop.helpTitle: Read the Story Behind Each One
shop.helpText: Every scent in the collection is written like a small place: a rice field at harvest, a misty lake at dawn, a lantern-lit temple courtyard. See the full notes on the Our Story page.

about.headerText: A home fragrance brand inspired by Thai and Lanna cultural heritage, blended with the serenity of nature in Northern Thailand.
about.missionTitle:
Sharing the Beauty of
Thai Lanna Heritage
about.missionText1: Poetiq is inspired by the delicate artistry of Lanna pattern and the serene nature of Northern Thailand. Through refined home fragrance creations, the brand shares the beauty of Thai Lanna heritage with people around the world, while reflecting Thailand's cultural wisdom and roots.
about.missionText2: Each fragrance is crafted around the highland forests of Chiang Mai, the oolong tea plantations of Chiang Rai, and the lantern festival of Sukhothai — inviting people to experience the roots of Lanna culture, the richness of nature, and the Thai way of life.
about.symbolText: The Poetiq mark is drawn from two Lanna characters — "Phor Phan" (พ) and "Ror Ruea" (ร) — adapted and interlaced with traditional Lanna woven textile patterns into a single, connected form. The trademark has been registered with Thailand's Department of Intellectual Property.
about.communityText: Poetiq collaborates with local communities to develop artisan skills in provincial areas, creating additional income alongside the production process. Materials and packaging are chosen to be safe for health and the environment — avoiding plastic and minimising waste through less-waste production.
about.galleryText: Every scent in the collection is built around a place — a memory of Northern Thailand you can bring home.
